label: OTTO Advertising (OTTO Retail Media)
terms_note: OTTO Market partner (seller or service partner) with API credentials (OAuth2 client credentials to api.otto.market); SPA interface listed among functional interfaces; reporting limited to the last 90 days excluding today. Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials (OTTO Market API partner credentials)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (OTTO Market API — Sponsored Product Ads + SPA Reporting interfaces) Confidence: **high** — official docs read.
auth: 1. OTTO Market seller / service-partner account → API credentials in the Partner Portal.
3. Call the Sponsored Product Ads and SPA Reporting interfaces.

endpoints.call: Sponsored Product Ads — create / update campaign
endpoints.notes: name, budget, pacing, startDate, endDate, status

endpoints.call: SPA Reporting — pre-aggregated KPIs · on-demand CSV report

reference.limits: - Rate limits per OTTO Market API docs (TODO(verify)); free; OTTO Market partner terms; reporting window 90 days.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of a self-app created in OTTO Partner Connect > API-Zugriff with the advertising-services scope (https://api.otto.market/docs/sellers-integration).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The app's client secret (shown once in OPC). Tokens last 1800 s and are re-minted with the client credentials (no refresh token).

me.note: GET /v1/sponsored-product-ads/campaigns?limit=1: confirms the client credentials and the advertising-services scope (the partner is derived from the token).

list_campaigns.note: GET /v1/sponsored-product-ads/campaigns (the token's partner; account_id is not sent, `status` is not a filter). `budget` is budget.amount in EUR for the period in raw.budgetType (DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY or LIFETIME). Cursor paging: only the first page is returned.

update_budget.note: PATCH /v1/sponsored-product-ads/campaigns/{id} (application/merge-patch+json) {budget: {amount, currency: EUR}}: a whole-euro amount (minimum 20) applied to the campaign's existing budgetType, which cannot be changed, so it is a daily budget only for DAILY campaigns; spends money. The write is asynchronous: 202 returns a changeRequest (status PENDING) to poll at /v1/sponsored-product-ads/change-requests/{request_id}; only one pending change per campaign (409 otherwise).

pause_resume.note: PATCH /v1/sponsored-product-ads/campaigns/{id} {status: PAUSED|ACTIVE} (only ACTIVE or PAUSED campaigns). Asynchronous: the returned changeRequest status is PENDING until OTTO accepts it. Resuming restarts spending.

not_offered.list_accounts: The token's partner identity determines the data ("There is no need to pass the partner identity as a parameter; it is derived from the token", https://api.otto.market/docs/functional-interfaces/sponsored-product-ads-reporting); there is no account listing.
not_offered.get_report: Synchronous "GET /v1/spa-reporting/campaign-performance" returns one totals object per campaign (not rows) and full reports are asynchronous CSV jobs polled by reportId (https://api.otto.market/docs/functional-interfaces/sponsored-product-ads-reporting); the runtime can neither wrap a single object as rows nor poll and download CSV reports.
